properties.chose:
`include_edges` ON get_node, bounded, returning each edge's type, direction, other end and its own properties (evidence and note included). It is reachable by find_tools for "a node with its edges".

Rejected: a new neighbours tool, because the tool surface is budgeted (req:the-mcp-surface-is-sized-for-tokens-per-task).

The persona fact-checker hit the same wall on 2026-10-02: no read tool returns edge endpoints.

Anthony, 2026-10-02: "I accept all your recommendations."
properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony's idea 18 in art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02 (the VS Code `--call` door guide at 2b95bb4, 2026-10-02), in his words: "An edge reader: `get_node` with `include_edges`, or a `neighbours` tool that `find_tools` returns. Fixes 19." Limitation 19: "No edge reader. get_node takes no edges option, and find_tools does not surface a neighbours tool."

WHAT IS MEASURED (fact:root-cause-no-served-read-returns-one-nodes-edges-and-the-nearest-is-an-impact-walk-2026-10-02):
- get_node returns properties only.
- propagate_from at max_depth 1 is the nearest reader. It gave 6 of the 7 edges on a test node, dropped AUTHORED_BY, labelled impact direction rather than from→to, and showed no evidence.
- topic_report gives counts per edge type. Only export_graph is complete.
- find_tools ranks get_node 8th and propagate_from 14th for the report's phrase.
- The lesson that names the workaround rides only get_node's tools/list description, which a door agent never reads.

THE OPTIONS:
(a) `get_node` gains `include_edges` (off by default), returning {edge_type, from_id, to_id, the other node's type and name, the edge's properties including evidence}, filterable by direction and edge type, and budgeted. CHEAP: the store already reads edges by node, as propagate_from does. get_node's description then honestly says "and its edges", which is what find_tools ranks.
(b) A separate read-only tool (`neighbours` / `get_edges`): id, direction, edge_types, limit, and a description in the asker's words ("what is this connected to", "its edges", "who links to it"). Same cost as (a), and one more tool on a 195-tool surface.
(c) Name propagate_from depth 1 as the edge reader in its description and in get_node's. Cheapest, but it keeps the gaps: no AUTHORED_BY, impact direction, no evidence.
(d) Nothing new: read the export, as the report does today. Costs the whole design per question.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS, kept beside it:
- Reply size: degree is skewed on reflow2's own design. The median node has 3 edges, the 99th percentile 225, who:ajs 936, a release about 640. Any form needs a budget and a cut-off that says what it left out, the way topic_report reports its own bounds (req:the-mcp-surface-is-sized-for-tokens-per-task).
- (a) changes the reply of the most-called read. It must stay off by default so that consumers relying on `{node}` (flo2's gateway among them) see no change.
- (b) grows the catalogue that find_tools exists to make searchable.
- Neither (a) nor (b) reaches a door agent's attention unless find_tools can rank it, so the words in the description are half the fix.

A ranking is a finding, not a decision. Anthony rules.

DATED NOTE 2026-10-05 (triage of art:vscode-call-field-log-2026-10-05): RAISED AGAIN in an entry dated 2026-10-05, measured on 0.76.0: `get_node` with `include_edges` was refused as an unknown field while copying how an earlier PR Artifact had been linked, and find_tools for "list edges of a node" surfaced no reader, so the committed export was read instead. The log infers "a read-only 'edges of node X' tool (or an `edges` flag on `get_node`)". That is what this decision accepted and 0.78.0 built (#659); on main, find_tools for "list edges of a node" now ranks get_node fourth. The work machine still runs 0.76.0, so this recurrence is the release lag, not a new gap.
properties.name: ACCEPTED 2026-10-02 — get_node takes include_edges (bounded, with each edge's evidence), and find_tools finds it for "a node and its edges"
properties.rationale: Why it is worth recording: an absence claim made from get_node alone was measured wrong on 2026-09-28 (the why was one edge away). The door field report hit the same wall and fell back to reading a 27 MB export. The design's edges are what make it a graph rather than a list, and today no read hands one node's edges back as edges.
